findings.claim: The scan gate never scans `.prometheus/scan-allowlist.json`, so PHI or real secrets placed in the committed allowlist can pass with exit 0.
findings.evidence: The scanner explicitly skips the allowlist file with `if (path.resolve(file) === path.resolve(allowlistFile)) continue;`, while `openspec/specs/agent-tooling/karpathy-logging/spec.md` requires that committed `.prometheus/` content pass the PHI/secret scan and the knowledge curator must run this scan before proposing any commit of `.prometheus/`.
findings.suggested_fix: Scan `scan-allowlist.json` as well, or add a dedicated validation step that rejects allowlist entries matching PHI/secret rules unless they are known synthetic fixtures under a separate reviewed mechanism.
